parameters.description_en:
The Device ID. You can obtain this parameter by calling [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~).  
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the **ProductKey**/**DeviceName** combination, **IotId** takes precedence.
